# Parcel Pals workshop

Read and follow the tutoring and maintenance guidance in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
The learner's open-ended pointers are in [WORKSHOP.md](../WORKSHOP.md).

Help participants own their observations, hypotheses and decisions. Explain
concepts and help implement their chosen approach rather than completing the
entire exercise unprompted. Explicit facilitator maintenance requests should
be implemented directly.

Keep synthetic, preview and live evidence separate. Never invent results.
